# First, let me verify what dateutil_tz.tzutc() returns vs datetime.timezone.utc
from datetime import datetime, timezone as dt_timezone
from dateutil import tz as dateutil_tz

dt1 = datetime.now(dt_timezone.utc)
dt2 = datetime.now(dateutil_tz.tzutc())

print("timezone.utc type:", type(dt1.tzinfo))
print("tzutc type:", type(dt2.tzinfo))
print("Are they equal?", dt1.tzinfo == dt2.tzinfo)
print("tzutc offset:", dt2.utcoffset())
print("utc offset:", dt1.utcoffset())
